# Spanish Grand Prix Preview

Verstappen and Norris collide on Madrid's treacherous new circuit as unforgiving barriers punish the slightest error in high-speed corners. Russell's crash warnings signal a minefield for midfield teams seeking breakthrough moments, with strategy calls on tire management and pit timing becoming decisive factors. A flawless drive Sunday could reshape the championship fight, rewarding precision while crashes eliminate contenders from points-scoring positions entirely.
